messages:
Marie: Heads-up — benchmark across eu-west and us-central showed weird p99 regressions on PCIe nodes vs SXM ones for the new q4 model. Baseline A100-SXM (on-prem) p50~21ms p99~33ms, PCIe A100 (cloud) p50~24ms p99~52ms. Batch=1, seq=512.

infra-bot: perf-bench job #4821 finished — results uploaded to https://redwood-internal.storage/bench/4821

Jasper: can you paste `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `numactl --hardware` outputs? Also which kernel (cutlass/triton/cuBLAS) was used?

Marie: sure, here are clipped outputs:
```
# nvidia-smi topo -m
GPU0    GPU1    CPU Affinity    NUMA
GPU0    X       NODE 0          0-7
GPU1    NVLINK  NODE 1          8-15
```
```
# numactl --hardware
available: 2 nodes (0,1)
node 0 cpus: 0-7
node 1 cpus: 8-15
```
We were running Triton with default kernel selection + 4-bit quant via group-quant plugin.

Anil: looks like GPUs are on different NUMA domains and connected by NVLink only between some pairs. If process landed on node 0 but GPU1's CPU affinity is node1, you get cross-node PCIe hops. Try `numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 ./triton_server` pinned to GPU1's NUMA. Also set `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1` per worker.

Olga: another vector — kernel choice matters heavily for quantized kernels. On PCIe instances we saw cutlass kernels fall back to slower GEMM paths. Try forcing `TRITON_BACKEND_GPU_SM::KERNEL=cuBLASLT` or the newer `cutlass_mixed` for 4-bit. Also collect `nvprof` traces for a slow tail.

Marie: quick experiment: pinned server to node1, p99 dropped from 52ms -> 34ms on PCIe A100. So NUMA was a big factor. Still ~1ms worse than SXM but acceptable.

Jasper: great. Next steps: 1) run a 24h canary with NUMA pinning enabled and kernel set to cuBLASLT on a small fleet (us-central PCIe). 2) add telemetry to Redwood Console: per-route NUMA mismatch rate and kernel variant used. 3) update onboarding doc for model-quant guide.

devops-bot: created ticket INF-948: 'PCIe NUMA pinning + kernel tuning for q4 models' assigned to @Marie and @Jasper

Marie: noted, will run canary tomorrow and post perf dashboard link. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Jasper: also FYI, if you see frequent p2p stalls check `nvidia-smi topo -m` for "PXB" vs "PHB" — cloud PCIe root complex can sometimes reorder traffic.

Olga: adding: quant calibration differences can surface as more kernel branching — monitor `kernel_mispredict` counters if possible.

Marie: assigning myself for the canary and will cc infra for capacity sizing. I'll post results in this thread.

infra-bot: reminder — scheduled maintenance in us-central in 6h, may affect canary.

Marie: noted, will shift start after maintenance window.
